body:
I stumbled upon a large field area filled with passion flowers. I stopped and collected a good amount of dried leaves, stems, and flowers. I filled these into a pipe and lit up. At first I inhaled too quickly, not expecting the hot harshness of the smoke. It isnt too bad though, not enough to make me cough. I loaded about three bowls and started feeling the effects about halfway thru. Its very similar to a slight marijuana high, but more buttery. Overall its very warm and pleasant
